A '''nerve probe''' was a device designed to test [[Nervous system|nerve cell]] activity. However, it was also used in [[Torture/Legends|interrogations]] as it could be used to cause pain.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|371|nerve probe}}</ref>
